blocks.content:
Act: RTI Act, 2005
Type: Statutory + Quasi-Judicial
HQ: New Delhi
Max Commissioners: 10
Penalty: ₹25,000
Purpose: Transparency & Accountability

items: Type of Body: Remember that it is both Statutory and Quasi-Judicial.
Maximum Commissioners allowed under the Act is 10.
The maximum penalty limit frequently asked in exams is ₹25,000.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The RTI Act was enacted in 2005 to ensure transparency and accountability in governance.
The authority functions as both a Statutory and Quasi-Judicial body.
The central headquarters are established in New Delhi.
The body can have a maximum of 10 Information Commissioners.
Penalties for non-compliance can go up to a maximum of ₹25,000.
